mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing sertraline plasma concentrations, while both agents have CNS stimulant properties that may potentiate serotonergic and stimulant effects.
action: Monitor for increased sertraline side effects (tremor, agitation, insomnia); consider sertraline dose reduction if adverse effects emerge; counsel on serotonin syndrome symptoms.
